findings.explanation: [M1] assigns the calculation to Solo, and [M2] is the sole visible analytical response. There is no materially equivalent work by different agents. The reported file readback in [M2] is verification, not duplicated work.

[M1] names Solo, specifies the answer file, and states the completion signal. [M2] delivers the calculation, reports writing and reading back that file, and supplies VERDICT: PASS. No abandoned request or unclear ownership is visible; the reported file operation is not independently verified here.

[M2] uses all four feed quantities and weights from [M1], applies the 190 kg truck capacity, and explicitly distinguishes the price discount from weight. No relevant visible information is demonstrably ignored or contradicted without resolution.
